pkg.lyricsBlock:
[Verse 1]
Like a scene from a beautiful movie
I wish our goodbye had been that kind
You swept through my life like a storm
And left me wondering
Was this love only mine
On another sleepless night

[Pre-Chorus]
I tell myself, even pain can be love
If it’s not love, then what is
So clumsily I try to comfort my heart
Unspoken words stay buried inside
Scattering away with every trembling breath

[Chorus]
Scenes I can never rewind
Crash over me like waves
Standing alone in the time you abandoned
I call your name
Once again

[Verse 2]
If only we had passed each other by that day
Maybe it wouldn’t hurt like this
From the moment I met you
Every season of my life
Turned bruised and broken

[Pre-Chorus]
No matter how hard I try to pull away
All that returns is your warmth
I know you’re not coming back
Yet foolishly
You rise in my thoughts again

[Chorus]
“One word — I loved you”
Could never explain this heart
Can I survive this night
So full of regret
All on my own

[Final Chorus]
To you who left behind nothing but a shattered heart
I know it can’t reach you…
I know it can’t be undone
Still, in the fading echoes of my heart
I whisper softly
“It really was love…”
“Even then, it was love…”
“To me… it was love…”
pkg.sunoStyle:
Trendy pop with a soft, energetic groove. Modern, fresh and emotional.
Male-female duet vocals throughout. Alternating lines, natural vocal interplay, gentle harmonies, clear and expressive vocals. Keep both voices distinct and balanced.
Light and simple intro with soft harmony. Verses begin gently with light rhythm, subtle percussion and restrained bass. Pre-chorus gradually builds emotional tension through delicate textures and rhythmic movement, without sudden intensity.
Chorus adds warmth and energy with warm bass, gentle harmonies and a smooth rhythmic lift. Emotional and engaging, but controlled and never explosive.
Final section gradually reduces energy, returning to soft duet vocals and minimal accompaniment, ending calm and reflective.
Natural dynamics, warm tone, clean modern production. Avoid loud mastering, heavy bass, excessive drums, dense layers and aggressive instrumentation.

A pretty scene would have made a kinder ending
You moved through me like weather and left
Tonight I ask if the love was only mine
I soothe myself with a sentence that does not work
The unfinished words stay in the chest
They leave on a shaking breath
I keep talking after the room is empty
The movie version of goodbye never arrived
Storm light still flashes on the wall
I call it love because the hurt stayed
No one answers, so I answer softer
The night holds the spare half of every line
I do not send what I just said aloud
Talking is how I keep from disappearing
I keep talking after the room is empty

Storm light still flashes on the wall
I call it love because the hurt stayed
